Looks like it's this key that is unknown and causing the error: `"BSH.Common.Program.Favorite.001"`. We should make sure we don't do any requests with unknown keys.

In fact, we already do that here:
https://github.com/home-assistant/core/blob/42f55bf271ab872754a112d842e7edb54b05de78/homeassistant/components/home_connect/coordinator.py#L451-L460

but not here:
https://github.com/home-assistant/core/blob/42f55bf271ab872754a112d842e7edb54b05de78/homeassistant/components/home_connect/coordinator.py#L396-L399

review_comments: Can we add a test that line 397 is now also guarded by the check for unknown keys?
